title: Realme P Series Drives Growth for the Brand in India
summary: Realme's affordable P series powered the brand's growth in India in H1 2026, becoming the fastest-growing lineup on Flipkart and helping Realme secure the second-largest market share for the period. The brand ranked number one in the Rs 10,000–15,000 segment and placed in the top three across higher price bands. Despite a 10% overall market decline in Q2, Realme held a 10% market share. The company has exited China to concentrate on international markets like India and will begin rolling out ColorOS updates with Android 17.
content:
Realme shared that its affordable P series helped drive growth for the brand in the Indian market during the first half of 2026. Flipkart data showed that the P series became the fastest-growing smartphone lineup on the platform in H1 2026, a performance that contributed to Realme securing the second position in overall market share for the period.

On Flipkart specifically, Realme ranked number one in the Rs 10,000 to Rs 15,000 price segment, a performance attributed to the popularity of the P series. The brand also performed strongly in the Rs 15,000 to Rs 20,000 and Rs 20,000 to Rs 25,000 segments, where it ranked among the top three.

Market research firm Counterpoint reported that the overall Indian smartphone market declined by about 10% in Q2 2026. Even so, Realme maintained a double-digit market share, holding roughly 10% of the market during the quarter.

In a related strategic move, Realme announced its exit from China. The company said leaving its home market would allow it to focus on international markets such as India, improve operational efficiency and reduce internal competition with sister brands including OnePlus and OPPO.

Realme also confirmed a software strategy shift: its phones will begin receiving ColorOS updates starting with Android 17. ColorOS will be rolled out to OnePlus devices alongside Android 17. Separately, OnePlus has been narrowing its global footprint, exiting some international markets such as North America and Europe to improve profitability and concentration.

Realme reiterated that India will remain a focal market as the brand pursues growth overseas. Readers are invited to follow TelecomTalk for further updates on Realme and other smartphone brands.
